In the same joint read, extract only explicit section 151(b) or 151(c) givens from current facts. Preserve subsection, taxpayer, other person, taxpayer year, and positive or negative polarity. A section 151(d) statement, marriage, kinship, income, absence of marriage, or target question is not a b/c given. Never manufacture both polarities. Each record requires an exact facts witness; complete [] is finite absence and unread uses null.

Extract marriages expressly stated in current facts and preserve both spouses. Use ongoing_since for continuing wording, onset_only for a stated commencement without supported persistence wording, and closed_interval only with both endpoints. Every record requires facts evidence. The question cannot establish a marriage. Do not invent an endpoint or reject onset_only merely because no end exists. complete [] is finite absence; unread uses null.

Extract only deaths expressly stated in current facts. Preserve deceased person and actual death date. A target question, queried person, clause, or year cannot establish or witness a death. Deduplicate identical records. Every record requires facts evidence; complete [] is finite absence and unread uses null.

Extract only family relationships, shared residences, and births expressly stated in current facts. related_person bears relation_type to reference_person; do not reverse it. Preserve all residents, one shared location identity, supported endpoints, and actual birth dates. Do not infer residence from kinship, age from labels, or a joint return from marriage. Every positive record needs facts evidence; complete [] is finite absence and unread uses null.

Extract blindness facts only. Preserve the blind person and use onset_only for a stated onset, ongoing_since for explicit continuing wording, closed_interval for two endpoints, and active_on_date for an explicit dated status. A spouse's blindness is not the taxpayer's. Do not invent recovery, permanence, or the legal year-end conclusion. Every positive record needs facts evidence; complete [] is finite absence and unread uses null.
